location.travelNote: Expo City is a published walking estimate; the other destinations are driving estimates. These are community estimates, not live routing or measured distances from a specific home. Starting point, route and traffic can change the journey.

floorPlans.label: Emaar: Terra Woods Building 1 floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published Building 1 apartment plans. Match the unit number and level on each sheet; layouts and areas can differ within a type. Townhouse and other-building residence plans are not included in this published document.
floorPlans.note: Plans and dimensions are approximate and subject to developer revisions. Drawings are not to scale; shown furnishings and generic view legends do not guarantee a particular unit’s outlook or sale inclusions.

review.images: All six selected image masters visually reviewed. Own official brochure embedded originals used rather than the670px website previews; no editing/upscaling/stock substitutions. Final browser visual review caught and corrected a brochure-background selection before completion; reviewed page13 living-space original replaces it. Page13 identifies the room as multipurpose; its displayed label follows that source.
review.location: Exact official pin and regional map checked. Brochure physical3 reviewed;5min walk to Expo City distinguished from10/15/35min drives. Community estimates qualified.
review.floorPlans: All18 Building 1 residence title/area panels visually checked, physical4–21; complete unedited sheets and original PDF retained. First numeric area column is sqft, second sqm. Decimal variants retained; repeated type names carry sheet number. Scope limitation explicitly shown.

unavailable: The official linked floor-plan PDF covers Building 1 apartments only. Other-building and townhouse residence plans were not present in that document or the reviewed official page links; no substitutes were added.
